entities.title: Only the everyday operations
entities.summary: expand, equivalent and the other operations of docs/operations.md, recurrences and canonical round-tripping are not implemented; the conformance profiles claimed are none yet, and no registries are shipped.
entities.impact: Recurrences, series, uncertain values and the other kinds can be validated structurally but not evaluated; operations on them return unsupported (unsupported-operand).

entities.title: Proleptic Gregorian only
entities.summary: Civil values in any other calendar are unsupported (unsupported-calendar).
entities.impact: A Julian or Hebrew date can be held as JSON but not checked, compared or converted.

entities.title: No leap-second table
entities.summary: Second 60 is unsupported (leap-second), and SI seconds can't be added to a POSIX instant (needs-leap-seconds).
entities.impact: 23:59:60 and elapsed-time arithmetic on instants need a library or a later version that has the table.

entities.title: No 24:00
entities.summary: 24:00 is unsupported (end-of-day): it needs an end-of-day policy.
entities.impact: End-of-day times must be written as the next day's 00:00.

entities.title: ISO 8601 extended format only
entities.summary: Week dates, ordinal dates and basic format are unsupported (unsupported-form); annotations other than one [Area/Location], and a [zone] after Z or -00:00, are unsupported (unsupported-annotation).
entities.impact: Text in those forms must be converted before it is parsed.

entities.title: No EDTF qualifiers or decimal periods
entities.summary: 1347~, 1347?, 134X and decimal period components such as P1.5M are unsupported (unsupported-form).
entities.impact: Approximate and partly unknown dates have to be written as uncertain values in JSON.

entities.title: POSIX instants only
entities.summary: Instants are implemented only on the unix-posix timescale with ticks; others are unsupported (unsupported-operand).
entities.impact: TAI, GPS, TT and other timescales can be validated but not computed with.

entities.title: Typed values cover the everyday shapes
entities.summary: The typed layer holds dates, months, times, date-times (floating, fixed-offset, zoned), POSIX instants, the three amounts and date or instant intervals. Anything else, or a value with extra properties such as resolutionPolicy or provenance, is unsupported (unsupported-operand) in from_json.
entities.impact: Such values stay usable through the JSON layer's functions only.
entities.workaround: Use the JSON layer (utv.resolve, utv.add, …) on the dict.

entities.title: No arithmetic on a time of day
entities.summary: CivilTime has no add methods, and the JSON layer's add on a time is unsupported (unsupported-operand).
entities.impact: Adding to a time of day needs a date: wrapping past midnight would lose the day.
entities.workaround: Attach a date with date.at(time) and add to the CivilDateTime.

entities.title: Date and instant intervals only
entities.summary: contains and overlaps handle civil-date intervals with date points and instant intervals with instant points, built from a start and an end.
entities.impact: Date-time, start-plus-amount and other intervals are unsupported (unsupported-operand); dates in different zones are unsupported (different-zones).

entities.title: datetime's range and precision
entities.summary: Converting to datetime holds only years 1–9999 and whole microseconds; UTC offsets with fractions of a second can't be converted from datetime.
entities.impact: Such conversions are unsupported (out-of-native-range, unsupported-operand) unless allow_loss=True, which reports what it dropped.

entities.title: Python's int–string conversion limit
entities.summary: An integer string longer than Python's int–string conversion limit (4300 digits by default) can't be read.
entities.impact: Such a year gives resource-limit (implementation-limit) in the JSON layer and Unsupported in the typed layer.
entities.details: The status differs from the shared code table (src/utv/.dev/backlog.json, implementation-limit-status).
